title: Seeded defects

# Seeded defects

The engine doesn't read this file twice.

The organisation writes one catalogue for each colour.

The rule reads the the next sentence.

The check reads a element and an rule.

The team will leverage the index to find a document.

The parser keeps the span, and the rule reads it; the check writes nothing.

The engine reads every document that the census found under the root, and it writes one finding for each rule that a document fails, so a reader can find each one.
